title: Callbacks for events
description:
Let game code register functions to call when something happens.

```
on("death", playSound)
on("death", addScore)
fire("death") -> sound played, score +100
fire("jump")  -> nothing registered
```
hints: A plain function pointer cannot hold a lambda that captures; that is what `std::function` adds.
requirements: A map from event name to a list of plain function pointers `void (*)(int)`.
`fire(name, value)` calls them in the order they were added.
Then do the same with `std::function` and a lambda that captures a counter.
stretch: Return an id from `on` so a listener can be removed.
